newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania bank assets rise in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania bank assets rise in third quarter.

text.p: The assets of Lithuania's banking sector rose by 11 percent in the third quarter of the year, the central bank said on Monday.
The bank said in its quarterly report that commercial banks' assets were 7.68 billion litas in the third quarter, compared with 6.9 billion litas the previous quarter.
Lithuania's banking system is still getting over a crisis that hit it at the end of last year. Bank assets fell to 6.68 billion litas from 7.15 billion litas in the first quarter of the year.
The central bank said that in the third quarter foreign investors held 37 percent of the country's government Treasury bills.
It said that foreigners held 471.3 million litas of Lithuanian paper of the 1.27 billion litas in issue.
London-based investors were by far the most active with just over 25 percent of the total amount of T-bills in issue while Latvian banks were second with 87.5 million litas.
Average yields on Lithuanian T-bills soared at the start of the year after the banking crisis and reached around 40 percent. They are now around 11 percent to 14 percent.
